text: Recommendation: split #2928 into (a) a prerequisite domain/wire issue — "wire kind:39000 into nmp-content's EmbedKindProjection + FlatBuffers embed_sidecar wire" (nmp-content + nmp-nip29 + gallery-app dispatch updates), and (b) keep #2928 scoped to just the 4 platform card components + registry manifests once (a) lands.
